headline: RERA Registered. Every Project. Every Time.
intro: The Real Estate (Regulation and Development) Act makes registration compulsory, but it does not make a builder transparent. We publish every registration number, escrow every rupee you pay, and invite you to verify us on the regulator portal before you trust us with a booking.

commitments.title: Registered Before Sale
commitments.text: No unit is offered, advertised or booked before the project carries a live GujRERA registration number.

commitments.title: 70% Escrow Discipline
commitments.text: Seventy percent of every collection goes into the project-designated escrow account and is withdrawn only against certified construction progress.

commitments.title: Quarterly Filings
commitments.text: Progress, approvals and financials are filed with the authority every quarter and are publicly viewable against our registration number.

commitments.title: Committed Possession Date
commitments.text: The possession date in the registered agreement is the date we are legally bound to, with the statutory compensation clause intact.

commitments.title: Carpet Area Pricing
commitments.text: Every quote, cost sheet and agreement is priced on RERA carpet area. We do not price on super built-up and we do not revise area after booking.

commitments.title: Five-Year Defect Liability
commitments.text: Structural and workmanship defects reported within five years of possession are rectified at our cost, as the Act requires.

buyerRights: Ask for the RERA registration number before paying any booking amount.
Verify that number yourself on the GujRERA portal, not on the builder website.
Insist on carpet-area pricing in the cost sheet and the agreement.
Check that the possession date in the agreement matches the RERA filing.
Pay only into the project account named in the registered agreement.
Keep the quarterly progress filings in view. They are public and free.
